descriptions.networkTraffic: Data transmission/reception speed across physical and virtual network interfaces.
descriptions.networkRx: Volume of incoming network data. Helps identify download spikes and inbound system load.
descriptions.networkTx: Volume of outgoing network data. Helps identify upload spikes and outbound system load.
descriptions.networkErrors: Number of corrupted packets or hardware errors at the network card level.
descriptions.tcpIpStack: Rate of new TCP connections. Active Opens = outbound (we connect to others). Passive Opens = inbound (others connect to us).
descriptions.tcpRetransmits: eBPF tracking of retransmitted packets per IP. Indicates connection quality issues or path loss.
descriptions.tcpDrops: Deep kernel monitoring (eBPF). Shows packets dropped by the kernel or network stack. High values suggest congestion or firewall blocking.
descriptions.tcpRetransSegments: Total count of retransmitted TCP segments system-wide (metric from /proc/net/snmp).
descriptions.udpTraffic: Statistics of received and transmitted UDP packets.
descriptions.socketStates: Real-time network socket usage. Helps monitor connection limits.
descriptions.conntrackUsage: Connection tracking table occupancy percentage (nf_conntrack). If it reaches 100%, the server will start dropping new connections.
descriptions.activeSockets: Current number of open network sockets in the system.
descriptions.icmpTraffic: ICMP message throughput rate. Unusual spikes may indicate ping floods or routing issues.
